newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telerj started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telerj started as buy.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities Inc. said in a statement it has initiated coverage of Brazil's Telerj with a buy rating at a price of $104.24.
-- Telerj, the second largest subsidiary of the Telebras system, "is poised to deliver positive earnings and normalized cash flow growth of 150 percent in 1996," it said.
-- The firm's anticipated 266 percent jump in capital expenditures during 1996 should help Telerj grow faster than other Brazilian telecom firms, it said.
-- It said Telerj's shares represent a good value compared with other Latin American and worldwide telecom companies.
-- Telerj preferred shares were traded at 109 reais, down 0.64 percent.
